subject: E-Commerce
title: International Shipping Costs
description: A micro-lesson that makes International Shipping Costs usable.

hook.text: International shipping costs 5-10x more than domestic. A $5 domestic shipment can cost $30-50 going overseas.

buildup.text: Cross-border shipping involves multiple carriers, customs clearance, and handoffs between logistics networks.

discovery.text: Consolidation services group multiple packages into one large shipment and distribute locally at the destination.

twist.text: Free international shipping is almost always subsidized by the seller eating the cost. It's never truly free.

climax.text: Shipping cost is the #1 reason cross-border shoppers abandon their carts. Getting it right is existential.

punchline.text: 5-10x domestic costs. Shipping is the biggest barrier in cross-border trade.

quiz.question: What is the #1 reason cross-border shoppers abandon their carts?
options: International shipping costs that are too high
